an6.44:1.1: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya yena Migasālāya upāsikāya nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
an6.44:1.2: Atha kho Migasālā upāsikā yenāyasmā Ānando ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho Migasālā upāsikā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ etad avoca:-- 2.
an6.44:2.1: Kathaṃ kathaṃ nāmāyaṃ bhante Ānanda Bhagavatā dhammo desito aññeyyo, yatra hi nāma brahmacārī ca abrahmacārī ca ubho samasamagatikā bhavissanti abhisamparāyaṃ?
an6.44:2.2: Pitā me bhante Purāṇo brahmacārī ahosi ārācārī virato methunā gāmadhammā,
an6.44:2.3: so kālakato Bhagavatā vyākato ‘sakadāgāmī satto Tusitaṃ kāyaṃ upapanno' ti; petteyyo
an6.44:2.4: piyo me bhante Isidatto abrahmacārī ahosi sadārasantuṭṭho,
an6.44:2.5: so pi kālakato Bhagavatā vyākato ‘sakadāgāmī satto Tusitaṃ kāyaṃ upapanno' ti.
an6.44:2.6: Kathaṃ kathaṃ nāmāyaṃ bhante Ānanda Bhagavatā dhammo desito aññeyyo, yatra hi nāma brahmacārī ca abrahmacārī ca ubho samasamagatikā bhavissanti abhisamparāyan ti?
an6.44:2.7: ‘Evaṃ kho pan'etaṃ bhagini Bhagavatā vyākatan' ti. 3.
an6.44:3.1: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando Migasālāya upāsikāya nivesane piṇḍapātaṃ gahetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
an6.44:3.2: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando paccābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
an6.44:4.1: Idhāhaṃ bhante pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya yena Migasālāya upāsikāya nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
an6.44:4.2: Atha kho bhante Migasālā upāsikā yenāhaṃ ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho bhante Migasālā upāsikā maṃ etad avoca
an6.44:4.3: ‘kathaṃ kathaṃ nāmāyaṃ bhante Ānanda Bhagavatā dhammo desito aññeyyo, yatra hi nāma brahmacārī ca abrahmacārī ca ubho samasamagatikā bhavissanti abhisamparāyaṃ?
an6.44:4.4: Pitā me bhante Purāṇo brahmacārī ahosi ārācārī virato methunā gāmadhammā,
an6.44:4.5: so kālakato Bhagavatā vyākato "sakadāgāmī satto Tusitaṃ kāyaṃ upapanno" ti; petteyyo
an6.44:4.6: piyo me bhante Isidatto abrahmacārī ahosi sadārasantuṭṭho,
an6.44:4.7: so pi kālakato Bhagavatā vyākato "sakadāgāmī satto Tusitaṃ kāyaṃ upapanno" ti.
an6.44:4.8: Kathaṃ kathaṃ nāmāyaṃ bhante Ānanda Bhagavatā dhammo desito aññeyyo, yatra hi nāma brahmacārī ca abrahmacārī ca ubho samasamagatikā bhavissanti abhisamparāyan' ti?
an6.44:4.9: Evaṃ vutte ahaṃ bhante Migasālaṃ upāsikaṃ etad avocaṃ
an6.44:4.10: ‘evaṃ kho pan'etaṃ bhagini Bhagavatā vyākatan' ti.
an6.44:5.1: Kā c' Ānanda Migasālā upāsikā bālā avyattā ambakā ambakasaññā ke ca purisapuggalaparopariyañāṇe!
an6.44:5.2: Cha yime Ānanda puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an6.44:6.2: Idh' Ānanda ekacco puggalo sorato hoti sukhasaṃvāso, abhinandanti sabrahmacārī ekattavāsena.
an6.44:6.3: Tassa savanena pi akataṃ hoti, bāhusaccena pi akataṃ hoti, diṭṭhiyā pi appaṭividdhaṃ hoti, sāmāyikam pi vimuttiṃ na labhati.
an6.44:6.4: So kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā hānāya pareti no visesāya, hānagāmī yeva hoti no visesagāmī. 5.
an6.44:7.1: Idha pan' Ānanda ekacco puggalo sorato hoti sukhasaṃvāso, abhinandanti sabrahmacārī ekattavāsena.
an6.44:7.2: Tassa savanena pi kataṃ hoti, bāhusaccena pi kataṃ hoti, diṭṭhiyā pi paṭividdhaṃ hoti, sāmāyikam pi vimuttiṃ labhati.
an6.44:7.3: So kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā visesāya pareti no hānāya, visesagāmī yeva hoti no hānagāmī.
an6.44:8.2: ‘imassa pi te 'va dhammā aparassa pi te 'va dhammā, kasmā tesaṃ eko hīno eko paṇīto' ti? Taṃ
an6.44:8.3: hi tesaṃ Ānanda hoti dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya.
an6.44:9.1: Tatr' Ānanda yvāyaṃ puggalo sorato hoti sukhasaṃvāso, abhinandanti sabrahmacārī ekattavāsena. Tassa savanena pi kataṃ hoti, bāhusaccena pi kataṃ hoti, diṭṭhiyā pi paṭividdhaṃ hoti, sāmāyikam pi vimuttiṃ labhati.
an6.44:9.2: Ayaṃ Ānanda puggalo amunā purimena puggalena abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro ca.
an6.44:9.6: Tasmā ti h' Ānanda mā puggalesu pamāṇikā ahuvattha,
an6.44:9.8: Khaññati h' Ānanda puggalesu pamāṇaṃ gaṇhanto.
an6.44:9.9: Ahaṃ vā Ānanda puggalesu pamāṇaṃ gaṇheyyaṃ, yo vā pan'assa mādiso. 6.
an6.44:10.1: Idha pan' Ānanda ekaccassa puggalassa kodhamāno adhigato hoti, samayena samayañ c'assa lobhadhammā uppajjanti,
an6.44:10.2: tassa savanena pi akataṃ hoti, bāhusaccena pi akataṃ hoti, diṭṭhiyā pi appaṭividdhaṃ hoti, sāmāyikam pi vimuttiṃ na labhati.
an6.44:10.3: So kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā hānāya pareti no visesāya, hānagāmī yeva hoti no visesagāmī. 7.
an6.44:11.1: Idha pan' Ānanda ekaccassa puggalassa kodhamāno adhigato hoti, samayena samayañ c'assa lobhadhammā uppajjanti.
an6.44:11.2: Tassa savanena pi kataṃ hoti . . . pe . . . 8.

an6.44:13.2: Tassa savanena pi akataṃ hoti, bāhusaccena pi akataṃ hoti, diṭṭhiyā pi appaṭividdhaṃ hoti, sāmāyikam pi vimuttiṃ na labhati.
an6.44:13.3: So kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā hānāya pareti no visesāya, hānāgāmī yeva hoti no visesagāmī. 9.

an6.44:14.2: Tassa savanena pi kataṃ hoti, bāhusaccena pi kataṃ hoti, diṭṭhiyā pi paṭividdhaṃ hoti, sāmāyikam pi vimuttiṃ labhati.
an6.44:14.3: So kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā visesāya pareti no hānāya, visesagāmī yeva hoti no hānagāmī.

an6.44:16.8: Khaññati h' Ānanda puggalesu pamāṇaṃ gaṇhanto.

an6.44:17.1: Kā c' Ānanda Migasālā upāsikā bālā avyattā ambakā ambakapaññā ke ca purisapuggalaparopariyañāṇe!
an6.44:17.2: Ime kho Ānanda cha puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an6.44:18.1: Yathārūpena Ānanda sīlena Purāṇo samannāgato ahosi, tathārūpena sīlena Isidatto samannāgato abhavissa. Nāy-idha Purāṇo Isidattassa gatim pi aññassa.
an6.44:18.2: Yathārūpāya ca Ānanda paññāya Isidatto samannāgato ahosi, tathārūpāya paññāya Purāṇo samannāgato abhavissa. Nay-idha Isidatto Purāṇassa gatim pi aññassa.
an6.44:18.3: Iti kho Ānanda ime puggalā ubho ekaṅgahīnā
